name: AI-Hub 028 한국인 피부상태 측정 데이터 (dataSetSn=71645)
verifiedFrom: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leejeongho3214/NIA/main/tool/test.py (grade counts: dryness 5, pigmentation 6, pore 6, sagging 6, wrinkle 7)
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hpicsk/regional-ccm/main/data/processed/metadata.csv (subject_id, age, gender, skin_type, sensitive, equipment_id, angle, region)
verifyNote: Label schema and directory layout are confirmed from the official project code. The LICENCE tier is NOT confirmed: aihub.or.kr was unreachable, so the dataset page 이용약관 must be read before any shipping run.

dryness.note: Source grades 0-4 collapse onto ARU's 0-3; the top two source grades both read as 매우 건조.

pores.note: Source grades 0-5 collapse in pairs onto ARU's shipped 3-level pore scale.

tone.note: Keys are region-specific (forehead_pigmentation, cheek_pigmentation). Scope pins the lookup to the expert-grade block, because equipment.pigmentation is an instrument value on a different scale.

wrinkles.note: Keys are forehead_wrinkle / glabellus_wrinkle / perocular_wrinkle; source grades 0-6.

axesDeliberatelyAbsent.oil: There is no per-image sebum grade. info.skin_type (0-5) is a SUBJECT-level oily/dry phenotype, not an image label, and using it as one would teach the model to predict a questionnaire answer from a face.
axesDeliberatelyAbsent.redness: No erythema grade exists in this dataset.
axesDeliberatelyAbsent.trouble: No acne or lesion grade exists in this dataset.
axesDeliberatelyAbsent.moisture: equipment.moisture is a corneometer reading and supervises no camera head by design; it belongs in the instrument regression track, not the ARU product model.
axesDeliberatelyAbsent.sensitivity: info.sensitive is a SUBJECT-level self-reported flag, not a visible per-image label.

collapseMappingWarning: Every map above compresses a finer source scale onto ARU's coarser one. That is a product decision, not a fact about the data. Re-check it against reviewer agreement before treating collapsed grades as ground truth.
notes: 1,099 Korean subjects aged 14-69, three capture devices (DSLR / tablet / smartphone), up to 7 angles, 8 facial-region bounding boxes, five dermatologists grading plus instrument measurement. The smartphone arm is the part that transfers to a browser selfie; the DSLR arm is a different optical domain and should be weighted or held out accordingly.
